newsitem.title: USA: News Corp to retaliate vs Time Warner - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: News Corp to retaliate vs Time Warner - WSJ.

text.p: News Corp Ltd is planning retaliatory measures against Time Warner Inc following Time Warner's decision to carry the MSNBC news channel on its cable system instead of News Corp's Fox News channel, the Wall Street Journal reported Friday.

The article quoted a News Corp executive as saying the company notified Time Warner that legal action would be pursued. News Corp will also file comments with the Federal Trade Commission, which recently approved Time Warner's $6.7 billion acquisition of Turner Broadcasting System Inc.
News Corp also said it is preparing to challenge Time Warner's franchising agreements with local governments, the Journal said.
MSNBC is owned by General Electric Co.
Time Warner was not immediately available to comment on the article.
